name: perl-class-method-modifiers
description: This tool provides a lightweight way to hook into existing Perl methods using before, after, around, or fresh modifiers. Use when user asks to add hooks to methods, modify method behavior without using Moose, or execute code before or after a specific subroutine.
overview: `Class::Method::Modifiers` provides a lightweight way to hook into existing methods in Perl classes. It allows you to execute code before, after, or around a method without needing to manually manage `SUPER::` calls or complex method redispatching. This is particularly useful for creating pluggable architectures, adding logging/validation, or safely extending classes that do not use the full Moose object system.
